claims.sourceText: AARO Historical Record Report Volume I, p. 29, https://documents2.theblackvault.com/documents/dod/AARO_Historical_Record_Report_Volume_1_2024.pdf , 2024-02
claims.text: AARO's 'Report on the Historical Record of U.S. Government Involvement with Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena (UAP), Volume I', February 2024, carries at page 29, in Section V 'Assessment of Interviewee Claims of USG Involvement in Hidden UAP Programs', this sentence: 'An interviewee who is a former U.S. service member said that in 2009, while participating in a humanitarian and security mission in a foreign country, he encountered U.S. Special Forces loading containers onto a large extraterrestrial spacecraft.' The sentence is AARO's summary of an interview, not a quotation of the interviewee, and it names nobody.

claims.text: The same report states the anonymisation rule that is why the page 29 sentence names nobody: 'AARO generated random numbers and assigned one to each interviewee. AARO maintains the key, which is stored and handled in a secure manner to protect each interviewee's privacy.' It also gives the scale and the tiering: 'As of September 17, 2023, AARO interviewed approximately 30 individuals', with Tier 1 interviewees being 'those who have spoken with congressional staff or Members of Congress and have been subsequently referred to AARO'.

b.label: 10 U.S.C. 119 - Special Access Programs: Congressional Oversight

edges.label: A program can be designed and formally requested without ever crossing the congressional reporting threshold
edges.note: AARO: 'KONA BLUE was not reported to Congress at that time because it was never established as a SAP and, therefore, did not meet the threshold for congressional reporting.' The government states the gap in its own defence.

edges.label: KONA BLUE was proposed by AAWSAP's contractor team after DIA cancelled the program
edges.note: AARO records that when DIA cancelled AAWSAP/AATIP its supporters proposed a new version to DHS under a special access program, with lines of effort closely mirroring those the private sector organisation had conducted.

edges.label: The proposal's premise was that existing holdings would be moved into a structure Congress could see
edges.note: AARO records the proponents' belief that creating the program under DHS 'would allow all of the technology and knowledge of these alleged programs to be moved under the KONA BLUE program' where it could be properly monitored by oversight committees.

edges.note: Plant 42 is compartmented program by program inside a single fence line, which is the physical form of the concealment architecture at issue.

edges.label: Battelle's authorship of Special Report No. 14 was deliberately concealed behind an ATIC cover
edges.note: AARO states that Battelle 'released a report under the cover of ATIC to maintain its anonymity.' The first public analytical product of the government's UFO investigation was ghost-written by a private contractor at the contractor's request.

edges.note: AARO notes the material 'was only assumed to exist by KONA BLUE advocates and its anticipated contract performers,' and that the proposed lines of effort mirrored the private sector organisation's AAWSAP work.
